roster.name: Digital DJ Tips // Learn To DJ

ideas.title: Ninja DJ: stealth transition
ideas.image_alt: AI persona as a ninja DJ: black outfit, dark headband with tails, mask pulled down, gold-and-white headphones, hand over the mixer
script: 0–2s: decks playing song A, empty frame, text on screen: 'shh… 🥷'
2–6s: you sneak in low from the side of the frame in the ninja look (black outfit, headband tails, mask down around the neck, gold-and-white headphones)
6–9s: freeze for a beat, look straight into the camera, slowly raise one hand
9–12s: karate-chop the crossfader exactly on the drop; quick zoom-in and a whoosh sound; the beat switches to song B
12–18s: nod to the new track, then vanish out of frame (jump cut); the decks keep playing
Optional twist: swing two synth pedals tied by their cable like nunchucks, then stomp one to drop a filter sweep into song B
End text: 'comment a song for the next ninja drop'
ideas.caption: stealth mode: ON 🥷🎧 which drop should i sneak into next?

ideas.title: The one I've been saving

modeled_on.title: been wanting to share this with you guys for a while now…

script: 0–3s: no text, just the room or the decks; let the track start
3–8s: the drop or the moment hits; slow-mo optional
8–15s: cut to your face or the crowd reacting
End text: 'this one stayed in the drafts too long'
ideas.caption: been holding this one. needed to let it out.

ideas.title: They brought the heat
ideas.hook: No hook text for the first 2 seconds. Then the city or room name + a fire emoji.
script: Shoot from behind the decks toward the room (or a tight crowd cut if you're in it)
One clean drop, real-time, no jump cuts
End with a 3-word caption on screen: the place + 'brought heat'
ideas.caption: y'all showed up 🔥

ideas.title: If you know, you know
script: 0–3s: a small, almost private cue (a look, a knob, a vinyl label) — no talking
3–10s: the blend or the drop lands; keep the camera still
Last 2s: hold. Don't explain the tracks.
ideas.caption: if you know you know.

ideas.title: The unusual room

modeled_on.title: OUT NOW 📺 my set recorded live from INOTA POWERPLANT 🔋 link in bio 📡☢️🌪️

ideas.hook: Text: the room first, then the music. e.g. "Not a club."
script: Open on the space (garage, rooftop, empty hall, studio with the lights down)
Walk or cut to the decks already playing
One wide shot of the whole unusual room once the drop hits
End text: 'full set in the comments' or 'part 2?'
ideas.caption: recorded live from a room that isn't a club. link in comments.

ideas.title: Too early to be this creative

modeled_on.title: 10am at Space, Miami. Always trying to push my creativity ❤️

script: 0–3s: phone clock or a window with daylight, decks in frame
3–15s: one experimental blend or a stems/pedal move you wouldn't try at a packed hour
15–22s: the result, then a shrug to camera
ideas.caption: wrong hour, right idea.

ideas.title: New feature, 20-second tour

modeled_on.title: Introducing Live 13. Take the (de)tour on the link in bio.

ideas.hook: "The new thing in Rekordbox / your DAW, in 20 seconds."
script: 0–3s: big text with the feature name
3–20s: screen-record a tight tour — what it is, one real use on a track you play
20–30s: the before/after of that one use
End: 'save this before you update'
ideas.caption: quick tour of the new feature. save it.

ideas.title: First time on real speakers

modeled_on.title: fun fact the first time I tested HEAVEN on big speakers was at this decommissioned power plant in hungary 📡☢️🔋

ideas.hook: "First time this track heard real speakers…"
script: 0–4s: say or text where you first tested a new edit or pedal chain on a proper system
4–15s: play the moment that only works loud (sub, stereo width, a filter sweep)
15–22s: your reaction, no extra explanation
ideas.caption: fun fact: the first time this heard real speakers was here.

ideas.title: Announce the attempt

modeled_on.title: This still seems like a challenge I can't beat, but if I'm going to have any chance at all, I know I have to work harder than I've ever worked before. On December 4th the world will see my record attempt 💪🏼❤️

ideas.hook: "I don't know if I can beat this. I'm going to try anyway."
script: 0–4s: name a concrete challenge (a transition, a stems mix, a one-take set length)
4–15s: a short clip of you failing or almost landing it in practice
15–22s: on-screen date for the attempt; ask them to come back
ideas.caption: setting a date. hold me to it.

ideas.title: If this track were a person

modeled_on.title: If this song was a person it would be allowed to get a driver's license. Happy 16th birthday to PFUDOR!

ideas.hook: "If this track were a person, it could…"
script: 0–3s: the one-liner about a track you made or always play (age, job, personality)
3–15s: play the hook while a few stills or clips of when you first used it flash by
End text: 'happy ___ to this one'
ideas.caption: this one got older. still hits.
